Kit summary

New MoonBasic
Deals 140% ATK DMG to a single enemy. There is a 60% chance to inflict [Hypnotize] for 1 turn if the target's Turn Meter is no less than 50%; if it's below 50%, restores all allies' HP by 6% of Luna's Max HP.
MoonlightActiveExclusive Lv.1
Increases all allies' Turn Meters by 15%, and grants [Block Debuff] to them for 1 turn. Meanwhile, grants all allies (except for the main target) [Stealth] for 1 turn.
Moonlit Harp Lv.1Moonlight Blessing reduces 40% ATK now.
Moonlight BlessingPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
At the beginning of a turn, an ally will gain a layer of [Heal] for 2 turns if [Heal] doesn't work on this ally. Luna has a 100% chance to reduce 20% incoming ATK for 1 turn when she takes Direct DMG.
Moonlit Harp Lv.1Moonlight Blessing reduces 40% ATK now.
Moonlit Harp Lv.2Upgrades [Heal] granted by Luna to [Pure Energy]. When a turn starts, each layer of [Pure Energy] restores 10% of the Max HP for the caster.
QuietnessActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Cleanses all allies' 5 layers of DoT debuffs and all other debuffs. Meanwhile, grants them 1 layer of [Heal] for 2 turns. Increases the ATK of allies who have 50% or more HP by 40% for 2 turns. Restores the HP of allies who have less than 50% HP by 20% of Luna's Max HP. Revives the selected main target by 40% of Luna's Max HP and increases their Turn Meter by 40% if the target is dead.
Moonlit Harp Lv.2Upgrades [Heal] granted by Luna to [Pure Energy]. When a turn starts, each layer of [Pure Energy] restores 10% of the Max HP for the caster.
Moonlit Harp Lv.3Quietness: HP restoration (no requirements now) and ATK increase take effect at the same time.
